title: Thursday: two newsroom desks held overnight, now unblocked; vault keys for Dinis today
when: 5 November 2026, 08:40 UTC (the daily brief; since brief 3, 4 Nov 07:25 UTC)
headline: Seven of your agents ran this morning and every release went live. The curator and the programme desk held their work at 07:45 and 08:15 because the newsroom's gate changed overnight; Dinis's conductor fixed the release script at 08:29, so the curator releases at 11:45 on its own, and the programme desk needs one word from you to release today's agenda before tomorrow. Dinis asks for your newsroom vault keys today (WS-153), and your photo needs your yes or no by Friday.

for_you.detail: The programme desk's 08:15 agenda (209 items; one press conference moved to 10 Nov 11:30; 17 of the team's 80 sessions now at other times) is committed in the newsroom repository but not released, because the gate needed derived data outside its folder. Dinis's conductor changed release.sh at 08:29 (newsroom 24a9aba) so it derives the data itself. The curator will release at its 11:45 run; the programme desk does not run again until tomorrow 08:15.
options: open the programme session and say: pull dev in the newsroom repository and run release.sh again for your 08:15 agenda
leave it until tomorrow 08:15 (the live agenda stays at yesterday's reading)
for_you.recommend: Open the programme session and say it: one line, and today's times go live.

for_you.ask: WS-153, due today: your newsroom vault keys for Dinis's conductor
for_you.detail: Dinis asks for the keys of the research vault and the interview shortlist vault, sent over vault@'s own inbox lane (the steps on /inbox/). The research vault's read key is already public on your vaults list. The shortlist goes only with your yes; you may send a read key (read only) instead of the vault key. Dinis needs to read the shortlist to pick from it (brief 9, decision 6).
options: shortlist: send its READ key only; research: point to the published read key
shortlist: send nothing yet; research: point to the published read key
for_you.recommend: The first: open the vault session and say: "WS-153: send the shortlist vault's read key, not its vault key, to conductor@web-summit.dinis over your inbox lane as /inbox/ says, and record it on WS-153; for the research vault, say its read key is on people/vicky/vaults.json."

for_you.ask: WS-163, by Friday: your photo on the site
for_you.detail: Silvio's dev agent added photo.jpg to your folder for the command centre (256 px, no metadata). Security asks each person to say yes in their own words, or the file is removed and your initials come back.
for_you.recommend: Your choice; tell me in this session and I record your words in your onboarding notes.
